caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest with a flat lid, rendered in shades of brown to represent the wood grain. The chest has horizontal wooden slats or grooves running along its front and sides, with a decorative patterned border along the top edge. There is a metallic or gray handle affixed to each short side of the chest and a small metal keyhole at the center of the front panel, just below the border. The lid features a geometric inlay with a star or diamond pattern made from lighter and darker wood tones, contrasting with the main surface. The chest sits on a slightly raised, molded base, and the background is plain and uncolored with a light beige tone. There is a small artist's signature and some marked crosshairs near the corners of the image.
title: Chest
